svg.data-weight-configured-scope: configured with two fan trays, two RSPs, five fabric cards, and one PEM
svg.data-power-modules-v3: Version 3 power system - up to three AC power modules per system
svg.data-power-ac-input-current: 15 A maximum at 200 VAC; 13 A maximum at 220 to 240 VRMS (UK)
svg.data-power-ac-service-requirement: 20 A North America; 16 A international; 13 A United Kingdom
svg.data-power-ac-redundancy: at least two AC power modules required for N+1 redundancy for a fully configured system
svg.data-cooling-path: front-to-top-to-rear; inlet at the bottom front, exhaust at the lower rear
svg.data-fan-trays: two, FT0 above FT1, to the right of the card cage
